translations.text: I will make confession of all my sins to God almighty, and to all God's saints, and to you, man of God: whatever wrong I have seen or wrongly consented to;
of wrong words, wrong deeds, evil thoughts; evil desires, evil will; of cursing, of lying, of wrongful standing, of wrongful sitting; while I was walking, while I was riding, while I was sleeping,
while waking, while eating, while drinking; consuming food immoderately; of my vomiting, of adultery, of theft, of manslaughter, of false oaths, of my broken fasts.
I did not seek my church as I rightly should have; I did not honour [?] as I rightly should have. I did not honour the holy mass as I rightly should have.
I did not keep the holy law as I rightly should have. I did not fulfil my course of prayer as I rightly should have.
I was not [?] as I rightly should have been. I did not receive the needy as I rightly should have. I did not give alms as I rightly should have.
Without leave I gave what I should not have. Without leave I received what I should not have. I did not reconcile two people at odds, as I rightly should have.
